_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% directional movement over 73 windows and no breaker visible, HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — a forced directional guess in a 0-for-18 coil is how records get destroyed.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil; narrative describes Bitcoin 'waiting' for macro winds to pick a direction, which is the same HOLD expressed differently.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $66,500 with funding below 0.01% and spot ETF flows turning positive — signals genuine risk-on rotation out of Anxiety into Disbelief.
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC drops below $61,000 with VIX spiking above 20 and funding flipping negative — pushes score toward Panic/Denial and kills the recovery analog.
